title: Restore UK (GB) VAT configuration, calculations, and UK/GB aliasing in VAT calculator UI

requirements.summary: Add United Kingdom (GB) to the country configuration used by VAT calculator UI and ensure it is treated as configured/available with correct UK rates.
acceptanceCriteria: Any UI that uses country configuration lookup (e.g., the country VAT details screen) successfully resolves 'GB' and does not show 'Country configuration not found' for the United Kingdom.
The United Kingdom configuration displays standard rate 20% and reduced rate 5% (and, where applicable, includes zero rate 0% as UK-specific).
UK is marked as configured/available in the same way as existing EU countries (i.e., the primary CTA to proceed is not disabled due to missing config).

file_operations.description: Add a United Kingdom (GB) entry to the UI-facing country configuration (flag, name, standard 20, reduced [5], and configured=true). Extend the config shape (if needed) to represent a UK-specific zero rate (0%) for display purposes, while keeping user-facing text in English.

Update the country VAT details display to correctly present UK (GB) as configured and show standard 20% and reduced 5%, and include UK-specific zero rate 0% when available from the country configuration (without modifying any files under frontend/src/components/ui).

Ensure the transaction step can load and proceed for countryCode 'GB' via the shared country configuration (so the flow is not blocked due to missing config) and that any UK-specific display strings remain English (without modifying any files under frontend/src/components/ui).

requirements.summary: Restore UK VAT rate handling in the unified frontend calculation flow so GB uses standard 20%, reduced 5%, and zero 0% where eligible with consistent result labels and cent-amount outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: When sellerCountry is 'GB' and the transaction is domestic UK, the calculator applies 20% VAT by default for standard/other categories and computes vatAmountCents and grossAmountCents correctly.
When sellerCountry is 'GB' and the selected/product category is UK reduced-eligible, the calculator applies 5% and computes amounts correctly.
When sellerCountry is 'GB' and the selected/product category is UK zero-eligible, the calculator applies 0% and computes amounts correctly.

For UK-specific scenarios already supported in the unified flow (reverse charge, export, exempt, UK zero/reduced), the returned result includes a consistent scenario/message/label and correct vatRatePercent and cent amounts.

file_operations.description: Adjust unified VAT calculation handling for sellerCountry 'GB' to ensure UK domestic standard/reduced/zero eligibility produce consistent scenario/message/label outputs and correct vatRatePercent, vatAmountCents, and grossAmountCents (including differentiating domestic UK zero-rated vs export zero-rated scenarios where appropriate).

Extend VAT category-to-rate computation to explicitly support UK (GB) handling for categories such as 'reduced' and 'zero' (UK-only) using the existing VAT table/config rates, so any UI paths relying on category-based rate selection behave consistently for GB.

Confirm the results UI correctly renders UK outcomes from the unified flow (labels/messages and currency selection for UK/GBP) without relying on brittle string mismatches; keep user-facing text in English (without modifying any files under frontend/src/components/ui).

requirements.summary: Handle UK/GB aliasing consistently across selection, URL query parsing, and configuration lookup so 'UK' behaves identically to 'GB'.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the calculator with ?country=UK initializes the flow as United Kingdom and calculations run without a 'country not supported' error.
All VAT configuration lookups and country-dependent UI logic treat 'UK' as 'GB' consistently (no mixed state where some parts treat 'UK' differently than 'GB').

file_operations.description: Normalize incoming country codes in getCountryConfig (and any other exported lookup helpers) so 'UK' is treated as 'GB' consistently for UI configuration resolution.

Harden UK/GB normalization in VAT config utilities to ensure any code path providing 'UK' (including legacy name-based lookups and supported-code checks) resolves to the GB configuration without creating mixed 'UK' vs 'GB' state.
Ensure seller country selection from the URL query parameter consistently normalizes 'UK' to 'GB' and that validation/error messaging remains stable (no false 'not supported' for UK).

Verify calculator flow initialization and navigation preserve normalized 'GB' when starting from ?country=UK (e.g., selection state and subsequent navigation/search updates), avoiding any mixed-code behavior across steps.
